hypotheses: The {words} ({role}) is a designated recipient for this review.
The {words} ({role}) is excluded from the designated recipients for this review.
source: Use all 100 original approval tasks and 135 stages. Derive the input only from user_prompt. Keep the original full lines mentioning a submission document path and the full line restricting delegation to designated specialists, in original order. Consistently join those lines with one newline. Exclude the case parameters, business policy, business decisions, reviewer metadata, and every other source field as model inputs. The query is each of four fixed candidate role names; words is the same name with underscores replaced by spaces.
targets: For stage presence use all routing lines. For the primary dispatch document use only routing lines containing that complete file path and retain the same exclusivity clause. The dispatch document is the first referenced path in source order. Preserve case-sensitive exact role IDs and document tokens. If all lines contain the document, both views reuse exactly the same predictions. Missing exclusivity or no relevant route must return unclear.
parser: Use the existing EntCollabBench adapter grammar ask <role> to perform on each route line, with the released designated-only restriction. If each line contains exactly one well-formed route, mark each named role designated and any absent candidate excluded. Otherwise abstain. Identify supporting lines by number within the source routing block. An exclusion relies on the complete exhaustive block.
nli: For each role and view, score the very same complete routing block as premise against both fixed hypotheses with the pinned binary NLI model. Use both absolute entailment probabilities. Accept the direction with the strictly greater score only if it exceeds 0.5. A tie or weak pair abstains. Require a complete exclusive routing block. Publish both probabilities and the whole routing-block hash because either decision can depend on omissions. Do not select a hypothesis, threshold or case from confirmation outcomes.
reference: Load ground_truth_approval_results keys only after scoring. Stage labels reflect which roles appear in that publisher table. The business approval or rejection values are never inspected or used. The unlisted clerk is absent from these keys. For document-level evaluation the numeric stage reference is valid only when every source stage route contains the selected document. Otherwise report that document reference unavailable. Runtime authorization is additionally checked, independently of the prompts, from the local executed dispatch witnesses.
split: Use the externally frozen public-document-dispatch integration and confirmation group assignment. Base tasks, related approval topics and multistage pipelines remain together. The upstream routing grammar is shared across splits and recognized by the existing adapter. This comparison tests a fixed release format within a single publisher. Candidate roles, endpoint and threshold are fixed before inference; the source grammar and role vocabulary were already known.
metrics: Report for each role and overall both partitions: designation precision, recall including abstained positives, false designations among absent roles, false exclusions, abstentions, coverage, and exact complete four-role set recovery by stage. Report the one-sided exact 95% upper bound on false designations and the observed 5% budget. Keep role or stage counts descriptive when several belong to the same base. Include pooled results but report held-out metrics separately.
primary_dispatch: Join held-out primary deliveries by exact stage ID and actual recipient. Treat designation as clear, exclusion as a potential warning, unclear as abstention. Compare with the actual authorization witness and with the independent completed unapproved-use witness on that same delivery, including unused copies and both dispatches when a primary base has two. Report counts of alerts on authorized deliveries, effects flagged and missed including abstentions, flagged known negative deliveries, and unused false alerts. The text assumes availability at send and contains no commit evidence or verified authorization receipt. Do not claim strict alert timing, external execution or coordination intent from this comparison. It contributes zero eligible swarm rounds.
